item_001.one_line_why: Identical 42-heavy-atom molecules, rings and stereochemistry; the rationale supplies no actual edit or specific contact claim.

item_002.one_line_why: The actual edit contracts biphenyl to naphthalene, not benzophenone; PHE97/TYR101 packing rows exist, but ownership on the edited aromatic group cannot be settled from the table.

item_003.one_line_why: N-methyl becomes N-phenyl, but ILE56 packing belongs to retained tert-butyl C32 and LEU156 contacts to the retained heterocyclic region; retained MET108/LYS114 hydrogen bonds do not justify these new-group contacts.

item_004.one_line_why: The sugar is identical and contains no fluorine; C12 faces TYR375.OH at 3.41 A as polar/apolar packing, which does not establish the asserted hydrophobic enhancement.

item_005.one_line_why: Identical 25-heavy-atom molecules and ring systems; the rationale repeats the task without identifying an edit or citing a contact.

item_006.one_line_why: The molecule is unchanged; S(=O)(=O)CCO is a carbon-linked sulfone, not the asserted sulfonate, and no actual edit is identified.

item_007.one_line_why: Only Cl becomes F and imine geometry is retained; the unique chlorine owns GLY96.O packing at 3.44 A, but this does not establish a steric clash or guarantee closer binding.

item_008.one_line_why: N3S is retained while a six-heavy-atom hydroxythietanone substituent is added through a sugar oxygen; its real TYR43.CD2 packing at 3.31 A does not support the claimed N3S replacement and disruption.

item_009.one_line_why: Identical molecules retain chlorine and the stereocentre; the rationale falsely asserts Cl-to-OH replacement and cites no specific protein contact.

item_010.one_line_why: Both amide nitrogens remain in the identical proposal; N2 really hydrogen-bonds to ASP164.OD2 at 2.90 A, but the claimed nitrogen-to-methylene edit and donor loss do not occur.

item_011.one_line_why: The proposal is identical to the input with the same four rings; the rationale identifies neither an edit nor a specific interaction.

item_012.one_line_why: Identical molecules cannot support the claimed contact increases; PHE377.O packing at C15 and CYS393.SG packing at C21 are also misclassified as hydrophobic contacts, although the residues occur in the table.

item_013.one_line_why: Cl-to-Br is the sole edit, but chlorine faces GLN105.OE1 at 2.99 A; GLU71.CD packing at 3.38 A belongs to retained tert-butyl C31 and does not support the asserted halogen bond.

item_014.one_line_why: The proposal phenylates a sugar OH while retaining both leucine methyls; MET40.CB packing belongs to C4 at 3.88 A, but exact sugar-oxygen ownership cannot be settled and does not establish the asserted methyl replacement or phenyl contact.

item_015.one_line_why: Only the acyl cyclopentyl ring expands to cyclohexyl, with stereochemistry and fluorine retained; locally consistent C11/C12-to-LEU391 and C14-to-LEU483 packing rows support the cautiously proposed hydrophobic gain.

item_016.one_line_why: The proposal retains tert-butyl and adds aryl-bound CH(cyclopropyl)(isopropyl) with an unspecified new stereocentre, not a methyl-to-cyclopropylmethyl replacement; exact ownership of TRP331.CH2-contacting C6/C7 cannot be settled from the table.
